flawed_step: Line 0003: “This subgraph must contain at least |C|+1 connected components.”
counterexample: Let n=4, V={1,2,3,4}, and E={{1,2},{2,3},{3,1}}. This graph has n-1=3 edges and a cycle C on vertices {1,2,3}, so |C|=3. After removing the cycle’s vertices and edges, the remaining subgraph consists only of vertex 4 and has exactly 1 connected component, not at least |C|+1=4.
assessment_summary: The concrete component-count claim used in the “only if” argument is false, so the proof as written is invalid, even though the theorem itself is true.
